newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentina's Nov fiscal deficit $843.4 mln.
newsitem.headline: Argentina's Nov fiscal deficit $843.4 mln.

text.p: Argentina posted a fiscal deficit of $843.4 million in November, the Economy Ministry said Wednesday.
While no official cumulative figures were provided, an analyst said the fresh data took the deficit in the January-November period to $5.33 billion.
The government has agreed with the International Monetary Fund on a $6.0 billion deficit for the entire 1996.
Including income from privatization, the deficit in November was $831.1 million, the ministry said.
Total current revenues were $3.78 billion and total current expenditures $4.39 billion, resulting in a $608.6 million deficit.
